newsitem.title: USA: Tyrex Oil says it merges with Kimbrough.
newsitem.headline: Tyrex Oil says it merges with Kimbrough.

text.p: Tyrex Oil Co said on Thursday that it had merged with Kimbrough Computer Sales Inc, a company specializing in Internet security.

In connection with the merger, Tyrex's directors approved a self-tender repurchase plan of about six million Tyrex shares at $0.30 per share, Tyrex said in a statement. The offer applies to shareholders of record on May 20, the company said.

In exchange for full ownership of Kimbrough, which does business as "3Si," Tyrex said it issued 28,333,333 restricted shares of its common stock to three people involved in the management of Kimbrough. The same three individuals were also appointed to the board of directors of Tyrex, the company said.

In addition, for $625,000 cash, Tyrex acquired a 1.5 percent royalty on Kimbrough sales from third parties not currently involved in its business, Tyrex said. As of March 31, Tyrex had 10,960,091 common shares outstanding.
